meta.description: Create and audit editable scientific posters in macro-free PowerPoint (.pptx) from author-approved local content and assets. Comprehensive workflow covering physical requirements, manifest building with approval/hashing, asset inventory, palette/contrast checks, generation with python-pptx 1.0.2, package security inspection, layout validation, and export planning. Use only when PowerPoint is the required deliverable with exact physical/printer/accessibility/provenance checks.

scientific_integrity.detail: Strong integrity framework: author approval bound to content hash, no fabrication of claims/numbers/citations, exact provenance for every element/asset

practice_boundaries.detail: Clear scope: only for PowerPoint deliverables; 8 hard gates including never fabricate missing material, never leave plausible placeholders

methodological_ground.detail: Based on python-pptx 1.0.2 with exact pinning, WCAG 2.2 contrast math, printer/conference requirements validation, accessibility standards

code_usability.detail: Production-ready with 7 bundled CLIs covering manifest validation, generation, security inspection, layout checks, asset inventory, palette audit, export planning

functional_suitability.note: Complete poster workflow: requirements, manifest with approval/hashing, generation, security inspection, layout validation, asset audit, palette check, export planning

reliability.note: Exceptional safety: 8 hard gates stopping on unmet conditions, exact pinning (python-pptx 1.0.2, Pillow 12.3.0, lxml 6.1.1), fail-closed drafts

performance_context.note: Efficient local-only generation; SKILL.md 259 lines dense with security/validation requirements; could benefit from quick-start summary

agent_usability.note: Strong structure with step-by-step workflow, 7 CLIs, templates, reference files; complexity high due to thorough safety requirements

human_usability.note: Clear scope statement (PowerPoint-only), hard gates prominent, workflow logical, approval/provenance requirements upfront

security.note: Outstanding: package inspector never extracts/executes, rejects macros/OLE/external links, bounded ZIP, manifest SHA-256 hashing, image metadata blocking

maintainability.note: Excellent: 5 reference files, exact dependency pins with -B bytecode avoidance, security validation document, dated source ledger, quality checklist

agent_specific.note: Deterministic generation from manifest; strong composability with approved assets; minor: integration with figure generation skills could be clearer

inputs.label: Manifest validation with author approval and content hash
inputs.note: Core workflow starting point with approval binding

assertions.text: validate_manifest.py checks author_verified on sources, author_approved on elements/assets
Content hash binds approval to exact manifest state
assertions.note: Non-approval edits invalidate approval by changing hash

assertions.text: Local PNG/JPEG paths with lowercase SHA-256 hashes required
assertions.note: Asset integrity verification built into manifest

assertions.text: Template in assets/poster_manifest_template.json with deliberate invalidity
assertions.note: Fail-closed design prevents accidental generation from template

inputs.label: Asset inventory with effective DPI and metadata blocking
inputs.note: Pre-generation asset audit with security checks

assertions.text: inventory_images.py fully decodes bounded images
Effective DPI = pixels / final placed inches, not metadata DPI
Blocks EXIF/XMP/comments and embedded text/application metadata
assertions.note: Privacy and security: metadata stripped before use

assertions.text: Output to JSON for review before generation

inputs.label: Palette check with WCAG 2.2 sRGB contrast

assertions.text: check_palette.py uses WCAG 2.2 sRGB mathematics
Contrast values are design targets not standalone conformance claims
assertions.note: Appropriate scope limitation for physical posters

assertions.text: Requires color-redundant labels, markers, shapes, patterns, line styles
Output to JSON with contrast pairs documented

inputs.label: Generation with exact pins and package inspection
inputs.note: Macro-free PPTX generation with security validation

assertions.text: generate_poster.py uses exact python-pptx 1.0.2, Pillow 12.3.0, lxml 6.1.1
assertions.note: Supply chain control with exact pinning

assertions.text: Never loads user template, creates blank presentation
inspect_pptx.py reads bounded ZIP metadata and XML only, never extracts/opens/executes
Rejects macros, VBA, ActiveX, OLE, embedded, executable, external relationships
assertions.note: Comprehensive rejection list but enforcement depends on correct inspector implementation

inputs.label: Layout validation with overlap and reading-order checks

assertions.text: check_layout.py validates against manifest specifications
Checks bounds, overlaps, reading order, final font size
Output to JSON with violations identified
Does not replace manual PowerPoint accessibility check

inputs.label: Export planning with CMYK and printer requirements
inputs.note: Pre-print preflight with color mode validation

assertions.text: plan_export.py assesses dimensions, scale, fonts, color, media
Blocks CMYK claim without printer-approved conversion/profile/proof
assertions.note: Honest limitation: native PowerPoint PDF is not CMYK-compliant

assertions.text: Output includes export plan and print readiness blockers
All 7 CLI scripts verified in scripts/ directory
assertions.note: CLIs extensively documented but directory not fully verified

key_strengths: Exceptional security: package inspector never extracts/executes, rejects macros/OLE/external links, bounded ZIP validation, SHA-256 asset hashing
Outstanding integrity framework: author approval bound to content hash, 8 hard gates stopping on unmet conditions, no fabrication/placeholders, exact provenance
Comprehensive workflow with 7 specialized CLIs covering manifest validation, generation, security inspection, layout, assets, palette, export planning
Strong accessibility emphasis: WCAG 2.2 contrast, color-redundant encoding, reading order, alt text in PresentationML, manual verification gate
Excellent version control: exact dependency pinning (python-pptx 1.0.2, Pillow 12.3.0, lxml 6.1.1), -B bytecode avoidance, dated source ledger
